testCase.name: [dev] S20b Real iOS and Android builds: a phone with the wrong date or time zone shows the same counts; VoiceOver and TalkBack announce a count change

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S20b 「真的 iOS 和 Android build：日期或时区错的手机显示一样的计数；VoiceOver 和 TalkBack 读出计数变化」 Real iOS and Android builds: a phone with the wrong date or time zone shows the same counts; VoiceOver and TalkBack announce a count change

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 'In Today' attendance is kept per day by the server clock, so the dashboard counts follow each server day's attendance. A device with a wrong clock or another time zone shows the same counts（TFA-92587 AC 6；UAT 3.8）
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3；TFA-92598 How it works 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given The same account on a real iPhone and a real Android phone (native builds) and on the web. Each phone's clock is set one day ahead and to UTC−10

When Open both dashboards on each device. With VoiceOver (iOS) or TalkBack (Android) on and a dashboard open, change one patient's status from the web

Then Identical counts and the same In Today residents on every device. The screen reader announces the new count without the physician moving focus. Both care settings

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 and TFA-92587 AC 6 for the clock part (date line recorded, judged after Q4); WCAG 4.1.3 status messages for the announcement. A person judges both

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S20b 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
